title: Make it a Quote Support AI Privacy policy
warning:
This page is an English translation of the Japanese version of the Privacy policy.
In the event of any discrepancy between the Japanese version and this page, the Japanese version shall prevail.
description: Neody has established the following privacy policy (hereinafter referred to as the "Policy") regarding the handling of users' personal information in the services provided on the Make It A Quote Support Discord server.

collection.title: Collection of personal information
collection.content:
When generating a response to a user's inquiry using an LLM, Neody temporarily collects

  • Text and images posted by the user to the support forum

This information is sent through the Vercel AI Gateway to providers that adopt a Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policy, and is discarded immediately after generation.

purpose.title: What is this information used for?
purpose.content:
The purposes for which Neody collects and uses personal information are as follows.

  • Generating a support message from the requested message.
